title: Senior Data Engineer - AI
description:
**Role Summary**

Design and implement agentic AI infrastructure on GCP, building configurable data analyst agents with multi-agent orchestration, knowledge graphs, security, and observability at scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* + Build multi-agent orchestration frameworks with memory and caching layers
  + Design and instrument knowledge graph architectures for agent reasoning
  + Develop conversational analytics using Gemini Enterprise, Google ADK, and MCP
  + Configure BigQuery Data Agents and address data quality/deep research issues
  + Implement end-to-end security and observability for production agents
  + Build ETL/ELT pipelines and analytics-ready datasets on GCP

**Required Qualifications**

**AI & Agents**

* + Strong understanding of LLMs, agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, and tool-calling concepts
  + Experience building with at least one LLM platform (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and exposure to modern agent frameworks
  + Familiarity with RAG architectures, agent memory systems, and prompt engineering through projects or self-directed learning
  + Strong foundation in software engineering that transfers well to agent systems development

**Data Engineering**

* + Advanced SQL and BigQuery expertise
  + Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines and designing semantic models
  + Knowledge of modern cloud data warehouse architectures

**Software Development**

* + Strong Python development skills
  + Experience with APIs, distributed systems, Docker

**GCP & Operations**

* + Working knowledge of GCP services (Compute, Storage, Data, ML/AI)
  + Understanding of cloud security best practices
  + Experience implementing observability and monitoring

**Nice-to-Have**

* + Vector databases, Vertex AI, or knowledge graph experience
  + Background in internal developer platforms or analytics infrastructure

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Experience : 8+ Years

No of opening - 1

##### **Responsibilities**

Lead and mentor a team of 8–15 engineers.

Manage technical delivery, sprint planning, architecture, and releases.

Oversee frontend, backend, mobile, and AWS cloud infrastructure.

Ensure code quality, CI/CD, testing, and production reliability.

Collaborate with Product and Design teams to deliver features.

##### **Requirements**

3+ years of Engineering Management experience, leading teams of 5+.

Strong hands-on experience in at least two: Python, React/TypeScript, iOS, or Android.

AWS experience: Lambda, Step Functions, RDS/PostgreSQL, S3, DynamoDB.

Experience with SaaS/B2B platforms, microservices, and monorepo architecture.

Knowledge of PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, and Alembic.

##### **Good to Have**

CI/CD, Docker, and SOC 2 compliance.

Mobile offline-first architecture and data synchronization.

AI/LLM integration experience.

Industrial, field services, or asset management domain experience.
